events.title: Solitary Fifty in Kolkata Fog
events.description: On New Year's Day, Dhoni prepared for the high-pressure clash against Pakistan at Eden Gardens, crafting one of his grittiest fightback fifties in overcast seam conditions.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni during an intense match in India colours

events.title: Selected for Landmark Pakistan Tour
events.description: Dhoni was selected for India's historic 2006 tour of Pakistan, his first major overseas Test tour where he would go on to announce his power to the world.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni in Team India kit

events.title: Masterclass 54* Against Pakistan
events.description: Dhoni fought valiantly with an unbeaten 54 off 89 deliveries against a fiery Pakistan pace attack at Eden Gardens, exhibiting his hallmark crisis-management skills.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in tough conditions

events.title: Stepping Down from Limited-Overs Captaincy
events.description: In a characteristically selfless move, MS Dhoni voluntarily stepped down as captain of India's ODI and T20I teams, passing leadership to Virat Kohli with remarkable dignity.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni: The Captain Leader Legend

events.title: Training for Maiden Pakistan Test Series
events.description: Dhoni engaged in intense net sessions at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore, adapting his aggressive front-foot technique against reverse swing ahead of the 1st Test.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in net practice sessions

events.title: Defending 167: Tactical Masterclass
events.description: At Feroz Shah Kotla, Dhoni marshaled his bowling troops to defend a modest total of 167 against Pakistan, winning by 10 runs through surgical field placements.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni orchestrating field placements

events.title: Resilient 57 at the Sydney Cricket Ground
events.description: Amidst a challenging overseas tour, Dhoni struck a fighting 57 at the SCG against Australia, demonstrating counter-punching resolve with the lower order.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Test whites in Australia

events.title: Named Captain of India A for Farewell Lead
events.description: BCCI announced Dhoni as captain of India A for warm-up matches against England at Brabourne Stadium, setting the stage for his final match as captain on Indian soil.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni ready for leadership

events.title: Domestic Commitment and Technique Work
events.description: Between international assignments, Dhoni regularly returned to domestic camps with Jharkhand, fine-tuning his keeping drills and explosive pull shots.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni enjoying training sessions

events.title: The Final Match as Captain: 68* at Brabourne
events.description: Dhoni walked out for the toss for the final time as captain for India A against England. He smashed 68* off 40 balls with 8 fours and 2 sixes amidst a memorable crowd invasion.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni salutes the Brabourne crowd

events.title: Fighting Run Chase at Rajkot
events.description: In high-scoring conditions against England at Rajkot, Dhoni anchored the chase with 32 off 25 balls, showcasing quick running between the wickets.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni pushing for runs between wickets

events.title: First-Class Ranji Trophy Debut for Bihar
events.description: An 18-year-old MS Dhoni made his first-class debut for Bihar against Assam at Keenan Stadium, Jamshedpur, scoring an unbeaten 68* in the second innings to seal a draw.
events.imageCaption: The beginning of a first-class journey

events.title: East Zone Dominance in Deodhar Trophy
events.description: Representing East Zone, Dhoni displayed brutal hitting against domestic spinners, underscoring his reputation as the country's most dangerous finisher.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launching a towering hit

events.title: The Historic Lahore Test Run-Fest
events.description: Dhoni took the field in his first Test match in Pakistan at Gaddafi Stadium, keeping wickets with precision as Sehwag and Dravid built a mammoth opening stand.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni behind the stumps in Test cricket

events.title: First Game as Pure Wicketkeeper Under Kohli
events.description: In the 1st ODI against England at Pune, Dhoni played his first match purely as wicketkeeper-batsman under Virat Kohli, providing invaluable DRS guidance from behind the stumps.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and Kohli sharing tactical insights

events.title: Duleep Trophy Heroics for East Zone
events.description: Dhoni showcased his counter-attacking prowess in the Duleep Trophy against top-tier bowling attacks, cementing his name on the national selectors' radar.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking with raw power

events.title: Adelaide Chase Masterclass: 55* off 54
events.description: Dhoni produced an ice-cool finish at the Adelaide Oval, scoring 55* with Virat Kohli (104) and finishing the game with a monstrous six off Jason Behrendorff.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in intense chase focus

events.title: MCG Triumph & Player of the Series: 87*
events.description: Dhoni scored an unbeaten 87* at the Melbourne Cricket Ground to guide India to an emphatic 2-1 bilateral ODI series win in Australia, earning the Player of the Series award.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni lifts his bat at the MCG

events.title: Sensational 134 in Cuttack with Yuvraj
events.description: In a vintage throwback at Barabati Stadium, Dhoni blasted 134 off 122 balls (10 fours, 6 sixes) in a monumental 256-run partnership with Yuvraj Singh (150).
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates a magnificent century in Cuttack

events.title: Cooch Behar U-19 Final: Gritty 84
events.description: Dhoni scored a resolute 84 for Bihar Under-19 against Punjab in the Cooch Behar Trophy final at Jamshedpur, a game forever remembered for Yuvraj Singh's 358.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni in representative cricket

events.title: Maiden Test Century: Blistering 148 in Faisalabad
events.description: Dhoni smashed his maiden Test hundred against Pakistan at Iqbal Stadium, Faisalabad—scoring 148 off just 153 balls with 19 fours and 4 sixes against Shoaib Akhtar and Danish Kaneria.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launches into his maiden Test century in Pakistan

events.title: Eden Gardens 5-Run Nail-Biter
events.description: Dhoni provided middle-order stability with 25 runs as India chased 322 against England in a thrilling finish decided by mere inches.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni focused on the target

events.title: Napier Masterclass & Sharp Stumping
events.description: Dhoni opened the New Zealand tour with razor-sharp keeping and lightning stumpings, guiding Mohammed Shami and wrist spinners to dismantle the Kiwis.
events.imageCaption: Lightning hands behind the stumps

events.title: Cuttack Blitz vs West Indies: 40*
events.description: Dhoni provided the late-order fireworks with an unbeaten 40* and effected two rapid dismissals to secure victory against the West Indies at Barabati.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni greets the cheering Cuttack fans

events.title: Padma Shri Honour Announced
events.description: On the eve of Republic Day, the Government of India conferred the prestigious Padma Shri upon MS Dhoni, recognising his inspirational leadership and ICC World T20 glory.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni honoured with Padma Shri

events.title: Republic Day Celebrations as National Icon
events.description: Celebrated across India on Republic Day as the new face of Indian cricket, inspiring millions from small-town India with his poise and leadership.
events.imageCaption: Captain Cool: An Indian Icon

events.title: Clinical Chase at Chepauk
events.description: Dhoni struck 22* to seal a smooth chase against the West Indies, receiving an ecstatic welcome at what would soon become his beloved IPL fortress.
events.imageCaption: Walking out at the MA Chidambaram Stadium

events.title: Mentoring Youngsters at Bay Oval
events.description: Dhoni spent hours mentoring young Indian batsmen and spinners in Mount Maunganui, exemplifying his transition into the team's elder statesman.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni sharing advice with teammates

events.title: Counter-Attacking 34 at National Stadium
events.description: After early wickets tumbled against Irfan Pathan's hat-trick in Karachi, Dhoni counter-attacked with 34 fearless runs in hostile conditions.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites in Karachi

events.title: 3-0 T20I Clean Sweep in Australia
events.description: Dhoni led India to a historic 3-0 clean sweep against Australia at the SCG, celebrating Suresh Raina's last-ball boundary with typical calm satisfaction.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates another T20 triumph

events.title: Blistering 40* off 20 Balls in Vadodara
events.description: Dhoni smashed an explosive 40* off just 20 deliveries to seal a 3-1 series victory over the West Indies, earning thunderous applause in Vadodara.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking clean boundaries under floodlights

events.title: Maiden T20I Half-Century: 56 at Bengaluru
events.description: After 76 T20I matches, Dhoni notched his maiden T20I fifty (56 off 36 balls) against England at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, powering India to a 75-run win.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat for his maiden T20I fifty

events.title: Planning for Steyn and South Africa
events.description: Dhoni led tactical meetings in Nagpur ahead of the crucial Test series against world No. 2 South Africa, formulating strategies against Dale Steyn.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni strategizing in team meetings

events.title: Rescuing India to 252 in Wellington
events.description: When India slumped to 18/4 against New Zealand, Dhoni's calming presence and middle-order guidance helped rebuild the innings, sealing a 4-1 series win.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni digging in during tough moments

events.title: Deodhar Trophy Power-Hitting
events.description: Representing East Zone, Dhoni dispatched experienced pacers onto the stadium roofs in the Deodhar Trophy inter-zonal competition.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni's effortless boundary power

events.title: Braving the WACA Pace Furnace
events.description: Dhoni showed extraordinary grit against Mitchell Starc and Peter Siddle on the fiery WACA bounce in Perth, putting his body on the line.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni battling through pace in Perth

events.title: Birth of Ziva Dhoni: 'On National Duty'
events.description: While captaining India at the 2015 World Cup in Australia, Dhoni's daughter Ziva was born. When asked if he would return home, he famously responded: 'I am on national duty, everything else can wait.'
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in contemplation on national duty

events.title: Peshawar Fireworks: 68 off 53 Balls
events.description: Dhoni played a sensational counter-attacking knock of 68 off 53 balls against Pakistan in Peshawar in a thrilling rain-affected ODI.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni bludgeons Pakistan in Peshawar

events.title: Smooth Finish at Eden Park, Auckland
events.description: Dhoni struck 20* with effortless composure to steer India to an easy 7-wicket win over New Zealand at Eden Park.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni finishing the match in style

events.title: Unbeaten 50* vs Sri Lanka in Adelaide
events.description: In the Commonwealth Bank Tri-Series, Dhoni anchored a tricky run-chase with an unbeaten 50* against Muttiah Muralitharan and Lasith Malinga.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni anchoring the chase in Adelaide

events.title: The 112m Adelaide Monster Six off Clint McKay
events.description: Needing 12 runs off the final over against Australia at Adelaide, Dhoni launched a colossal 112-metre six over long-on off Clint McKay, completing an unforgettable last-over victory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni holds the high follow-through of his 112m six

events.title: Rawalpindi 7-Wicket Rout
events.description: Dhoni combined with Yuvraj Singh to demolish Pakistan's bowling attack in Rawalpindi, guiding India to a comfortable 7-wicket victory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni acknowledges applause in Rawalpindi

events.title: The Australian Media Crowns Captain Cool
events.description: Following his Adelaide heroics, Australian commentators and newspapers heralded Dhoni as the undisputed coolest finisher in modern cricket history.
events.imageCaption: The Coolest Finisher in Cricket

events.title: Lahore 72* & Musharraf's Famous Hairstyle Remark
events.description: Dhoni blasted 72* off 46 balls with 13 boundaries in Lahore. During the post-match presentation, Pakistan President General Pervez Musharraf famously praised him: 'I saw a placard asking you to cut your hair. If you take my advice, you look good in it!'
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in his iconic long-hair era in Lahore

events.title: The Ice-Cool Final Ball Push to Tie at Adelaide
events.description: Needing 4 runs to win off the final ball against Sri Lanka in Adelaide, Dhoni kept his nerve and drove Lasith Malinga to deep cover, running 3 hard runs to tie the match.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni sprinting for the third run to secure a tie

events.title: World Cup 2015: Demolishing Pakistan in Adelaide
events.description: Dhoni led India to a dominant 76-run win over arch-rivals Pakistan at Adelaide Oval in front of 42,000 spectators, maintaining India's spotless World Cup record.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni directing his team in World Cup 2015

events.title: Multan Firestorm: 59* off 37 Balls
events.description: Dhoni tore into the Pakistani bowlers at Multan, hitting 59* in 37 deliveries with audacious pulls and drives to give India an unassailable 3-1 series lead.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni powers through the leg side in Multan

events.title: Tactical Squeeze at the MCG
events.description: In a tense low-scoring CB Series match at Melbourne, Dhoni's proactive bowling changes restricted Australia, laying the foundation for a historic series win.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni orchestrating the field at the MCG

events.title: Majestic 132* vs South Africa at Eden Gardens
events.description: Dhoni struck a glorious 132* at Eden Gardens, sharing an unbroken 259-run stand with VVS Laxman to secure an innings victory and protect India's World No. 1 Test ranking.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat for a match-winning Test century at Eden Gardens

events.title: Karachi 77* & 219 Series Average
events.description: Dhoni capped a dream tour of Pakistan with an unbeaten 77* off 56 balls in Karachi, finishing the 5-match ODI series with 219 runs at an incredible average of 219.00.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni salutes after a record-breaking series in Pakistan

events.title: Canberra Tactical Adjustments
events.description: Dhoni recalibrated India's fielding and running strategies during rain breaks in Canberra, establishing a blueprint for aggressive running between the wickets.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni discussing tactics during drinks break

events.title: 1-Run Thriller Victory in Jaipur
events.description: Dhoni's sharp wicketkeeping and nerve in the death overs helped India edge South Africa by just 1 run in a breathless finish at Sawai Mansingh Stadium.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni crouched in anticipation in death overs

events.title: World Cup 2015: 130-Run Rout of South Africa at MCG
events.description: Dhoni masterminded an emphatic 130-run victory over South Africa at the MCG in front of 86,000 roaring fans, shutting down AB de Villiers with direct-hit fielding.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading Team India onto the MCG

events.title: Launching the Chepauk Counter-Attack
events.description: On Day 2 of the 1st Test against Australia in Chennai, Dhoni walked in with India in trouble and launched an astonishing counter-offensive against Nathan Lyon.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni attacking through the off-side at Chepauk

events.title: Historic 224: Highest Test Score by an Indian Keeper
events.description: Dhoni smashed a magnificent 224 off 265 balls with 24 fours and 6 sixes against Australia at Chepauk—the highest individual score by an Indian wicketkeeper in Test history!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates his monumental 224 at Chepauk

events.title: Catching the National Selectors' Eye
events.description: Playing for East Zone in Jamshedpur, Dhoni's savage ball-striking against Central Zone caught the attention of selector Syed Kirmani and BCCI scouts.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni hitting big in domestic cricket

events.title: Rain-Shortened Battle at the SCG
events.description: Dhoni maintained immaculate focus behind the stumps in wet, slippery conditions at Sydney Cricket Ground, taking sharp catches off Umesh Yadav.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni directing the field in Sydney

events.title: World Cup 2011: The Epic 338-Run Tie in Bengaluru
events.description: In one of the greatest World Cup matches in history, India and England tied at 338 at Chinnaswamy Stadium. Dhoni contributed a vital 31 off 31 balls in the middle order.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in the heart-stopping 2011 World Cup tie

events.title: The Hobart Carnage: Chasing 321 in 36.4 Overs
events.description: Dhoni captained and guided India through an astonishing run chase against Sri Lanka in Hobart, where Virat Kohli's 133* chased 321 in just 36.4 overs for the bonus point.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni congratulates Kohli during Hobart blitz

events.title: Leap Day Team Address Before CB Series Finals
events.description: On leap day in Sydney, Dhoni held a historic team meeting, instructing his young squad not to celebrate wildly upon beating Australia, asserting India's dominance without drama.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni addressing the team with quiet confidence

events.title: Kharagpur Railway Days & Inter-Railway Cricket
events.description: While working as a travelling ticket examiner (TTE) in Kharagpur, Dhoni starred for South Eastern Railway, balancing long station shifts with thunderous cricket innings.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni reflecting on his early railway days

events.title: 1st CB Series Final Victory at the SCG
events.description: Dhoni combined with Sachin Tendulkar (117*) in an unbroken 73-run stand to guide India to an emphatic 6-wicket win over Australia in the 1st Final at the SCG.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni running with Tendulkar in Sydney

events.title: Asia Cup Dugout Leadership
events.description: Resting with a side strain, Dhoni spent the Asia Cup match against Pakistan advising stand-in captain Virat Kohli and analyzing opposition field weaknesses.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni advising teammates from the boundary

events.title: Historic CB Series Triumph at the Gabba
events.description: Dhoni's young India defeated Australia by 9 runs at the Gabba in Brisbane, winning the 2nd Final to claim India's first-ever ODI Tri-Series trophy in Australia!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates winning the CB Series in Australia

events.title: Unbeaten 84* in Napier Wind
events.description: Dhoni scored a dominant 84* off 89 balls against New Zealand in Napier, braving strong crosswinds to power India to a comfortable 53-run win.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni salutes after an unbeaten 84 in Napier

events.title: Asia Cup Final: 20* off 6 Balls & Trophy Lift
events.description: Needing 19 off 12 balls in the Asia Cup Final against Bangladesh, Dhoni unleashed 6, 4, 6 off Al-Amin Hossain to finish the match in a flash and lift the Asia Cup trophy!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni holds the pose after smashing the winning six in the Asia Cup

events.title: Dominant Form Across New Zealand
events.description: Dhoni continued his flawless limited-overs form across New Zealand, leading from the front with both the bat and wicketkeeping gloves.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading Team India in New Zealand

events.title: Innings Victory Over Australia at Hyderabad
events.description: Dhoni led India to a crushing victory by an innings and 135 runs against Michael Clarke's Australia, tightening the grip on the Border-Gavaskar Trophy.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni commands the field in Test whites

events.title: World Cup 2011: Clinical Chase vs Netherlands
events.description: At Feroz Shah Kotla, Dhoni chipped in with 19* to wrap up a 5-wicket victory against Netherlands on the march to World Cup glory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in World Cup 2011

events.title: World Cup 2015: 9th Straight World Cup Win
events.description: Dhoni led India to their 9th consecutive World Cup win across tournaments, defeating Ireland in Hamilton with clinical all-round execution.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni marches Team India forward

events.title: Christchurch Carnage: 68 in 392 Total
events.description: Dhoni smashed 68 off 58 balls in a 163-run partnership with Sachin Tendulkar (163*) as India amassed an overwhelming 392/4 against New Zealand.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates during the Christchurch run-fest

events.title: World Cup 2011: Nagpur Group Clash vs South Africa
events.description: In a thrilling group match at Nagpur, Dhoni fought to the end with 12*, learning critical tactical lessons that would later shape India's World Cup knockout strategy.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni watching play closely at Nagpur

events.title: Gutsy 64 Against England at Mohali
events.description: Dhoni scored a counter-attacking 64 in the 1st innings against Andrew Flintoff and Matthew Hoggard, establishing a match-winning first-innings lead.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Test whites against England

events.title: World Cup 2015: Match-Winning 85* in Auckland Chase
events.description: With India stumbling at 92/4 chasing 288 against Zimbabwe at Eden Park, Dhoni produced a masterful 85* off 76 balls with Suresh Raina (110*) to secure victory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni guiding the chase in Auckland

events.title: World T20: Fighting 30 on Turning Nagpur Pitch
events.description: On a raging turner at Nagpur against New Zealand, Dhoni was the lone Indian batsman to show composure, scoring 30 while wickets tumbled around him.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni evaluating the pitch conditions

events.title: Sachin's 100th Century & Dhoni's 21* Blitz
events.description: As Sachin Tendulkar scored his historic 100th international hundred in Mirpur, Dhoni supported at the death with a rapid 21* off 11 deliveries.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni applauding a teammate's milestone

events.title: The World Cup 2007 Turning Point in Trinidad
events.description: The heartbreak of India's early exit in the 2007 World Cup in the Caribbean proved to be the crucible that forged Dhoni's legendary resilience and calm demeanor.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in contemplation after early setback

events.title: Chasing 330 Against Pakistan in Mirpur
events.description: Dhoni calmly guided India through the final overs as Virat Kohli smashed 183 to complete India's highest successful ODI run chase against Pakistan.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni alongside Kohli in Mirpur

events.title: 100th ODI Win as Captain: World Cup Quarterfinal at MCG
events.description: Dhoni recorded his 100th ODI victory as Indian captain as India defeated Bangladesh by 109 runs at the MCG to advance to the World Cup semifinals.
events.imageCaption: 100 ODI Wins as Indian Captain

events.title: World Cup 2011: Defeating West Indies at Chepauk
events.description: At his beloved Chepauk, Dhoni led India to an 80-run win over West Indies, locking in India's berth for the historic quarterfinals.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni commanding the field at Chepauk

events.title: World T20: Clinical 7-Wicket Win Over Pakistan
events.description: Dhoni's spin choke with Amit Mishra and Ashwin restricted Pakistan to 130, setting up an effortless 7-wicket victory in their World T20 opener.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni placing fielders against Pakistan

events.title: Historic 4-0 Test Clean Sweep vs Australia
events.description: At Feroz Shah Kotla, Dhoni's India wrapped up a historic 4-0 whitewash against Australia, completing one of India's most dominant home Test series in history.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni holds the Border-Gavaskar Trophy

events.title: The 1-Run Miracle: Dhoni's Famous Last-Ball Sprint
events.description: Bangladesh needed 2 off 3 balls. 3 wickets fell in 3 balls! On the final delivery, Dhoni removed his right glove, anticipated the bye, and sprinted 20 yards to break the stumps and run out Mustafizur Rahman by inches, winning by 1 run!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni removes his glove for the famous 1-run runout sprint

events.title: World Cup 2011 Quarterfinal: Dethroning Australia
events.description: In Ahmedabad, Dhoni's India ended Australia's 12-year World Cup dominance in a heart-stopping quarterfinal chase completed by Yuvraj Singh and Suresh Raina.
events.imageCaption: Team India walks proud after beating Australia

events.title: East Zone's Fearless Domestic Powerhouse
events.description: Dhoni solidified his reputation in the Duleep Trophy, demonstrating that his counter-attacking style could demoralize any bowling attack.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking with trademark power

events.title: World Cup 2015 Semifinal: Valiant 65 at the SCG
events.description: Facing a massive target of 329 against Australia in Sydney, Dhoni stood tall amidst collapsing top-order wickets, fighting to the end with a brave 65 off 65 balls.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni battling to the end in the World Cup Semifinal

events.title: World T20: Iconic Chase with Kohli at Mohali
events.description: Dhoni smashed 18* off 10 balls and exhibited world-record speed running between the wickets with Virat Kohli (82*), storming into the World T20 semifinals.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and Kohli celebrate after chasing down Australia in Mohali

events.title: Deodhar Trophy Champion with East Zone
events.description: Dhoni lifted the Deodhar Trophy with East Zone, proving to Indian selectors that small-town cricketers from Ranchi could dominate the national stage.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni celebrating domestic trophy

events.title: Chepauk Test Run-Fest vs South Africa
events.description: Dhoni played in the famous Chennai Test where Virender Sehwag scored 319, adding a calm 19 as India posted 627 in response to South Africa's 540.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites at Chepauk

events.title: World Cup 2011 Semifinal: Beating Pakistan in Mohali
events.description: In front of both nation's Prime Ministers and a billion TV viewers, Dhoni led India to a historic 29-run victory over arch-rivals Pakistan to enter the World Cup Final!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni directing his troops in the 2011 Semifinal against Pakistan

events.title: World T20 Semifinal at Wankhede Stadium
events.description: Dhoni provided late acceleration with 15* off 9 balls in front of a packed Wankhede crowd as India set a formidable total of 192 in the World T20 semifinal.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni acknowledging the Wankhede crowd

events.title: Eve of the World Cup Final: Serene Focus
events.description: On the eve of the 2011 World Cup final, Dhoni addressed a packed press conference at Wankhede Stadium with trademark composure, stating India would treat it as just another game.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni calm on the eve of the biggest match of his life

events.title: World Cup 2011 Glory: 91* & The Immortal Six
events.description: India won the ICC Cricket World Cup after 28 years! Promoting himself to No. 5, Dhoni played a majestic 91* off 79 balls and finished with that unforgettable six over long-on off Nuwan Kulasekara at Wankhede Stadium. 'Dhoni finishes off in style!'
events.imageCaption: Dhoni watches the ball sail into the Wankhede crowd to win the World Cup

events.title: Conferred Padma Bhushan in Army Uniform
events.description: Seven years to the day after lifting the World Cup, Dhoni marched into Rashtrapati Bhavan in full Territorial Army uniform to receive India's third-highest civilian award, the Padma Bhushan, from President Ram Nath Kovind.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in military uniform receiving the Padma Bhushan

events.title: CSK Posts Mammoth 246/5 vs Rajasthan Royals
events.description: Dhoni scored 22 off 13 balls while Murali Vijay blasted 127 as CSK posted a towering 246/5 at Chepauk, defending it against Rajasthan in a 470-run match thriller.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni sending the ball into the Chepauk stands

events.title: IPL 5 Title Defense Begins at Chepauk
events.description: Dhoni led Chennai Super Kings out onto the Chepauk turf as defending champions against Mumbai Indians in the tournament opener.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni walking out at Chepauk in yellow

events.title: The Arrival: 148 off 123 Balls vs Pakistan in Vizag
events.description: Promoted to No. 3 by Sourav Ganguly, Dhoni announced his arrival to world cricket with a devastating 148 off 123 balls with 15 fours and 4 sixes against Pakistan in Visakhapatnam!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni unleashes raw power in his iconic 148 in Vizag

events.title: Explosive 51 off 26 Balls vs Mumbai Indians
events.description: Dhoni smashed 51 off just 26 balls with 5 fours and 3 towering sixes at Chepauk, battling fiercely against Mitchell Johnson and Lasith Malinga.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni blasting boundaries under Chepauk floodlights

events.title: CSK's Emotional Return to the IPL at Wankhede
events.description: After a two-year suspension, CSK made an emotional return to the IPL. Dhoni led the Yellow Brigade onto the Wankhede turf, sparking a fairytale season that culminated in the title.
events.imageCaption: CSK No. 7 returns under the lights

events.title: 2-Run Thriller Over KKR at Chepauk
events.description: Dhoni's astute captaincy defended 153 against Kolkata Knight Riders at Chepauk, winning the tournament opener by just 2 runs.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni commanding from behind the stumps for CSK

events.title: Rising Pune Supergiants Debut Win over MI
events.description: Captaining Rising Pune Supergiants in their maiden IPL match, Dhoni led his team to a comprehensive 9-wicket victory over defending champions Mumbai Indians at Wankhede.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading RPS at Wankhede

events.title: Chasing 203 in Emotional Chepauk Homecoming
events.description: In CSK's first home game in Chennai in nearly three years, Dhoni and Sam Billings chased down 203 against KKR in an emotionally charged Chepauk atmosphere.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni acknowledges the emotional roar of Chepauk

events.title: Test Captaincy Debut: Kanpur Victory vs South Africa
events.description: Stepping in for an injured Anil Kumble at Green Park, Kanpur, Dhoni captained India in Test cricket for the very first time, leading India to an 8-wicket win on a spin track.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni's first Test as Indian captain

events.title: Solid 47 Against Pakistan at Ahmedabad
events.description: Following his Vizag heroics, Dhoni proved his consistency with a mature 47 off 64 balls against Pakistan at Sardar Patel Stadium.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni greets the crowd in Ahmedabad

events.title: Perfecting the Helicopter in UAE Nets
events.description: In CSK's training base in Abu Dhabi, Dhoni spent hours honing the wrist snap and bottom-hand whip of his iconic trademark helicopter shot.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni unleashes the iconic helicopter shot

events.title: Padma Shri Investiture at Rashtrapati Bhavan
events.description: President Pratibha Patil officially conferred the Padma Shri on MS Dhoni at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi, acknowledging his status as an Indian sporting pioneer.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni at the Rashtrapati Bhavan ceremony

events.title: The Heroic 79* with Back Spasms in Mohali
events.description: Battling severe, excruciating back spasms, Dhoni played one of the gutsiest innings of his life, smashing 79* off 44 balls (6 fours, 5 sixes) against KXIP at Mohali.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni powers through back pain to launch huge sixes in Mohali

events.title: The Strategic Spin Trap for Chris Gayle
events.description: Dhoni deployed Ravichandran Ashwin in the opening overs at Chepauk to dismiss destructive opener Chris Gayle, orchestrating a clinical victory for CSK.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni setting the field for Gayle at Chepauk

events.title: Delhi Triumph in Maiden ODI Series vs Pakistan
events.description: Dhoni completed his breakout international series against Pakistan, winning hearts across the subcontinent and establishing himself as India's premier wicketkeeper.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni powering into the international spotlight

events.title: Dharamsala 54* & The Iconic Helmet Punch
events.description: CSK needed 16 in the final over to qualify for playoffs. Dhoni blasted Irfan Pathan for 4, 2, 6, 6 to pull off an impossible chase, famously punching his helmet in rare, raw emotion!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launches the winning six in Dharamsala

events.title: CSK's 1st Ever IPL Match: 240/5 at Mohali
events.description: Chennai Super Kings took the field for their inaugural IPL match. Michael Hussey hit 116*, Dhoni captained CSK to a 33-run win over KXIP, beginning the legendary 'Thala' era.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni with CSK teammates at the start of the IPL journey

events.title: Shane Watson Century & Dhoni's Leadership
events.description: Dhoni managed his seasoned squad expertly in Pune, backing Shane Watson (106) as CSK hammered Rajasthan Royals by 64 runs.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni congratulating Shane Watson

events.title: Breathtaking 84* off 48 Balls at Chinnaswamy
events.description: With CSK in dire straits at 28/4 chasing 162 against RCB, Dhoni produced an astonishing 84* off 48 balls with 7 sixes, nearly pulling off 26 off Umesh Yadav's final over.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launches a massive six into the Bengaluru night sky

events.title: Defending 142 in IPL Semifinal at DY Patil
events.description: Dhoni's tactical brilliance on a slow DY Patil pitch choked Deccan Chargers, defending a modest 142 with Doug Bollinger to guide CSK into the IPL 2010 Final.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni directing his field in the 2010 IPL Semifinal

events.title: Chepauk 6-Run Thriller Over Mumbai Indians
events.description: Dhoni struck a quick 30 off 16 balls and affected crucial run-outs as CSK edged Mumbai Indians by 6 runs in a classic early IPL rivalry match.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in the inaugural IPL season

events.title: Unbeaten 21* Finishing Chase in Kolkata
events.description: Dhoni held his nerve with 21* off 12 balls at Eden Gardens, calmly guiding CSK over the line with 4 wickets in hand.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni anchoring another chase in yellow

events.title: CSK Wins 1st IPL Trophy: The Pollard Straight Mid-Off Trap
events.description: Chennai Super Kings won their first IPL title! Dhoni set an unprecedented straight mid-off right beside the bowler for Kieron Pollard, who chipped the next ball straight to Matthew Hayden. CSK defeated MI by 22 runs!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and CSK lift their maiden IPL trophy in 2010

events.title: Blistering 43* in 9-Wicket Rout of KKR
events.description: Dhoni smashed an unbeaten 43* off 27 balls alongside Jacob Oram to crush Kolkata Knight Riders by 9 wickets in a rain-reduced game at Chepauk.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking cleanly under Chepauk lights

events.title: Epic 206 Chase at Chinnaswamy: 70* off 34 Balls
events.description: Chasing 206 against RCB, Dhoni teamed up with Ambati Rayudu, smashing 70* off 34 balls with 7 sixes, sealing the match by hitting Corey Anderson onto the stadium roof!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni watches the ball disappear onto the Chinnaswamy roof

events.title: Maiden IPL Fifty: 65 off 30 Balls at Bengaluru
events.description: Dhoni blasted his first IPL half-century, scoring 65 off just 30 balls with 9 fours and 3 sixes against RCB, silencing the Chinnaswamy crowd.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni smashes his maiden IPL fifty in Bangalore

events.title: Explosive 44 off 23 at Feroz Shah Kotla
events.description: Dhoni tore into the Delhi bowling attack with 44 off 23 balls, powering CSK to a crushing 86-run victory in the capital.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni hitting boundaries in Delhi

events.title: Carnage in Pune: 51* off 22 Balls vs DD
events.description: Dhoni produced death-overs carnage in Pune, smashing 51* off 22 balls with 2 fours and 5 enormous sixes as CSK posted 211/4 to win by 13 runs.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni lighting up the stadium in Pune

events.title: 44* off 22 & Lightning 0.08s Stumpings vs DC
events.description: Dhoni smashed Trent Boult for two sixes in the final over (44* off 22) and then effected two superhuman stumpings of Shreyas Iyer and Chris Morris in 0.08 seconds!
events.imageCaption: Lightning-fast gloves behind the stumps

events.title: Composed 32 in Chepauk Thriller
events.description: Dhoni scored a steady 32 off 27 deliveries against Delhi Daredevils, marshalling the middle overs in front of a passionate home crowd.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni entering the Chepauk arena

events.title: Mentoring Young Pacers Deepak Chahar & Shardul Thakur
events.description: During the 2018 IPL campaign, Dhoni worked intensively with young Indian pacers Deepak Chahar and Shardul Thakur, grooming them into international match-winners.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni sharing knowledge with young bowlers

events.title: Match-Winning 67* off 37 vs SRH in Hyderabad
events.description: Needing 15 in the final over, Dhoni launched Dale Steyn and Ashish Reddy into the stands, scoring an unbeaten 67* off 37 balls to snatch victory for CSK.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting with authority in Hyderabad

events.title: Clinical 31* to Sweep RCB at Pune
events.description: Dhoni finished off the chase with 31* off 21 balls, hitting three towering sixes off Yuzvendra Chahal to seal a 6-wicket win.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launching a six over long-on in Pune

events.title: Masterminding Chepauk Victory Over Mumbai Indians
events.description: Dhoni's field placements and bowling rotations suffocated Mumbai Indians to 139, as CSK strolled to a commanding 6-wicket win at Chepauk.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni commanding the field against Mumbai Indians

events.title: World T20: Raina Century & Dhoni's Finishing Touch
events.description: At Gros Islet in St Lucia, Suresh Raina scored India's first T20I century while Dhoni provided 16* off 6 balls in a dominant win over South Africa.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates with Suresh Raina

events.title: Spin Web Around Sunrisers Hyderabad
events.description: Dhoni utilized spin suffocations with Ashwin and Jadeja, forcing SRH into mistimed strokes to engineer a comfortable win.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni positioning the inner ring

events.title: World T20: Fighting Australia in Barbados
events.description: Dhoni struck 28 against a fiery Australian pace battery of Shaun Tait and Dirk Nannes on a bouncy pitch in Bridgetown, Barbados.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni pulling against extreme pace

events.title: Unbeaten 22* Steers Win at Wankhede
events.description: Dhoni held his nerve with 22* off 12 balls to guide CSK past Mumbai Indians in a tense rivalry encounter at Wankhede Stadium.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni at Wankhede Stadium

events.title: Devastating 67* off 23 Balls vs Sri Lanka in World T20
events.description: In one of the most explosive T20 knocks ever witnessed, Dhoni bludgeoned 67* off just 23 balls (5 fours, 6 sixes) against Sri Lanka at Gros Islet!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni smashes sixes all over St Lucia

events.title: IPL 2019 Final: Heart-Stopping 1-Run Cliffhanger
events.description: In an agonizing final against MI at Hyderabad, Dhoni was run out by mere millimeters. CSK fell short by 1 run, with Dhoni maintaining total grace and sportsmanship on the podium.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni looking on after the 1-run cliffhanger

events.title: Ambati Rayudu's Maiden Century Guided by Dhoni
events.description: Dhoni anchored from the other end with 20* as Ambati Rayudu scored an emotional maiden IPL century (100* off 62) against SRH in Pune.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni congratulating Rayudu on his hundred

events.title: Unbeaten 58* off 35 vs Delhi Daredevils
events.description: Dhoni smashed 58* off 35 balls with 4 sixes to post 168/4 and secure a 33-run victory over Delhi Daredevils at Chepauk.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launching into the Chepauk stands

events.title: Chepauk Fortress: Dominance over Delhi
events.description: Dhoni led CSK to an unbeaten home record during the 2011 IPL season, turning Chepauk into the most impenetrable fortress in world cricket.
events.imageCaption: Chepauk glows in yellow under Dhoni's leadership

events.title: Masterminding Playoff Combinations
events.description: Ahead of the IPL playoffs, Dhoni fine-tuned death bowling roles for Dwayne Bravo and Mohit Sharma, creating the most disciplined bowling unit in the league.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and Raina discussing tactical roles

events.title: Unbeaten 28* Sinks KKR at Eden Gardens
events.description: Dhoni struck 28* off just 13 balls to chase down KKR's 158 at Eden Gardens, silencing 65,000 Kolkata supporters.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking boundaries in Kolkata

events.title: CSK Clinches Top Seed in IPL 2011
events.description: With a dominant victory over Kochi Tuskers Kerala at Chepauk, Dhoni's CSK sealed the top playoff seed on their march to defending the IPL title.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading CSK out onto the field

events.title: 77-Run Rout of Delhi to Seal Playoff Spot
events.description: Dhoni led CSK to a thumping 77-run win over Delhi Capitals at Arun Jaitley Stadium, securing CSK's record 12th playoff qualification in 14 seasons.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and CSK celebrate another playoff qualification

events.title: Dhoni Knocks KXIP Out of IPL 2018
events.description: Dhoni scored 16* and marshalled his bowlers to defend 153 in Pune, knocking Kings XI Punjab out and sealing second place for CSK.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni behind the stumps in Pune

events.title: The Greatest Last-Over Heist: 23 Runs off Axar Patel
events.description: RPS needed 23 runs off the final over from Axar Patel. Dhoni produced one of the most astonishing finishes in cricket history: Dot, Wide+Six, Dot, Four, Six, and a final-ball Six over midwicket to win the match!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni holds the pose after smashing 23 off the final over in Vizag

events.title: Qualifier 1: Storming into the Final at Wankhede
events.description: Dhoni celebrated Faf du Plessis's heroic 67* as CSK pulled off an improbable 2-wicket win over Sunrisers Hyderabad to storm into the 2018 IPL Final.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and CSK celebrate reaching the final

events.title: The 4-Minute Masterstroke & 10th IPL Final
events.description: In Qualifier 1 vs Gujarat Titans at Chepauk, Dhoni calmly engaged the umpires in conversation for 4 minutes to ensure Matheesha Pathirana was eligible to bowl, securing victory and entering CSK's 10th IPL Final!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni talking with umpires in a masterstroke delay

events.title: Qualifier 1: Raina & Morkel Stun RCB
events.description: Dhoni led CSK to an extraordinary comeback win over RCB at Wankhede, with Suresh Raina (73*) and Albie Morkel sealing a spot in the 2011 final.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni congratulates Suresh Raina

events.title: Qualifier 2: Murali Vijay 113 & Dhoni's 23 off 10
events.description: Murali Vijay blasted 113 while Dhoni smashed 23 off just 10 deliveries as CSK piled on 222/5 to crush Delhi Daredevils by 86 runs and reach their 3rd straight final.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking at 230 strike rate in Qualifier 2

events.title: Lone Warrior 63* in IPL 2013 Final at Eden Gardens
events.description: With CSK reeling at 39/6 in the IPL final, Dhoni stood like a titan, scoring an unbeaten 63* off 45 balls with 3 fours and 5 sixes in a fighting solo display.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni saluting after his fighting 63* at Eden Gardens

events.title: Fairytale Title: CSK Wins IPL 2018 in Comeback Season
events.description: Chennai Super Kings completed one of the greatest sporting comebacks in history! Shane Watson's 117* sealed an 8-wicket win over SRH at Wankhede, as Dhoni lifted his 3rd IPL trophy with baby Ziva in his arms.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni lifts the IPL 2018 trophy with his team and daughter Ziva

events.title: Back-to-Back Champions: CSK Wins IPL 2011 at Chepauk
events.description: CSK became the first team in IPL history to defend their title! CSK amassed 205/5 (Murali Vijay 95, Dhoni 22 off 13) and dismantled RCB by 58 runs in front of an ecstatic Chepauk crowd.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni lifts the 2011 IPL trophy at Chepauk

events.title: 5th IPL Title: Jadeja's Miracle Finish & Dhoni's Lift
events.description: CSK needed 10 off 2 balls vs Gujarat Titans at 1:30 AM in Ahmedabad. Ravindra Jadeja smashed 6 and 4! An emotional Dhoni, with eyes closed during the final balls, picked up Jadeja in his arms in pure unbridled joy as CSK won their 5th IPL title!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni lifts Ravindra Jadeja in the air after the miraculous IPL 2023 win

events.title: Qualifier 2: Raina's 87 off 25 & Dhoni's 42*
events.description: After Suresh Raina's world-record 87 off 25 balls, Dhoni fought till the end with 42* off 31 balls in a mammoth 227-run pursuit at Wankhede Stadium.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in high-pressure Qualifier 2

events.title: Inaugural IPL Final: Last-Ball Drama at DY Patil
events.description: In the final of the groundbreaking 2008 IPL, Dhoni scored 29* off 17 balls as CSK set 163, with Rajasthan Royals edging victory on the very last delivery of the tournament.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in the inaugural 2008 IPL Final

events.title: Planning for Bangladesh Tri-Series
events.description: Fresh off the inaugural IPL, Dhoni assembled his squad in Kolkata to prepare for the triangular ODI series involving Pakistan and Bangladesh.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading strategy discussions

events.title: Refining Keeping Reflexes in Dhaka
events.description: Dhoni trained extensively in humid Dhaka conditions, working on staying low to keep to Indian spinners Anil Kumble and Harbhajan Singh.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni practicing low-keeping stance

events.title: Champions Trophy: 124-Run Demolition of Pakistan
events.description: At Edgbaston, Dhoni's mentorship helped Rohit, Dhawan, and Kohli post 319, as India bowled out Pakistan for 164 in a dominant 124-run DLS victory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni marshaling the team at Edgbaston

events.title: Conducting Wicketkeeping Clinics for Youth
events.description: During a brief rest window, Dhoni spent time in Ranchi mentoring budding local wicketkeepers on soft hands and anticipation.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni sharing wicketkeeping tips with youngsters

events.title: Afro-Asia Cup: Unbeaten 139* with Jayawardene
events.description: Representing Asia XI in Bengaluru, Dhoni struck a magnificent 139* off 97 balls with 15 fours and 5 sixes, sharing a world-record 218-run partnership with Mahela Jayawardene.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni acknowledges applause after his explosive 139*

events.title: Champions Trophy 2013: Cardiff Opening Win vs SA
events.description: Dhoni's new-look opening pair of Dhawan and Rohit flourished, while his tactical field setups strangled AB de Villiers and South Africa to win by 26 runs.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leads India out in the 2013 Champions Trophy opener

events.title: Champions Trophy 2017: 63 off 52 Balls at The Oval
events.description: Dhoni produced an explosive finish at The Oval, smashing 63 off 52 balls with 7 fours and 2 towering sixes to propel India to 321 against Sri Lanka.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launches into the stands at The Oval

events.title: World Cup 2019: Intensive Batting Drills at The Oval
events.description: Dhoni held an extended net session at The Oval, practicing targeted yorker-drives and lofted sweeps ahead of the clash against defending champions Australia.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni focused on ball-striking in nets

events.title: World Cup 2019: Blistering 27 off 14 vs Australia
events.description: Dhoni provided thunderous death-overs acceleration with 27 off just 14 balls (3 fours, 1 six), helping India amass 352/5 and defeat Australia by 36 runs at The Oval.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni finishes the innings in blue at The Oval

events.title: Afro-Asia Cup: Player of the Series Honour
events.description: Dhoni was named Player of the Series in the Afro-Asia Cup after scoring 174 runs in three matches at a staggering strike rate and average.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni with the Afro-Asia Cup award

events.title: Champions Trophy 2013: Clinical Rout of West Indies
events.description: Dhoni deployed Ravindra Jadeja (5/36) in surgical fashion, bowling West Indies out for 233 to seal an emphatic 8-wicket win and enter the semifinals.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni orchestrating the bowling changes at The Oval

events.title: India A Selection Confirmed for Kenya & Zimbabwe
events.description: Following brilliant domestic displays, BCCI selectors named 22-year-old Dhoni in the India A squad for the tour of Zimbabwe and Kenya—the tour that changed his destiny.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni selected for India A

events.title: Harare: Leading Young India to 8-Wicket Rout
events.description: Leading a young, second-string Indian team in Zimbabwe, Dhoni guided KL Rahul and Yuzvendra Chahal to a comprehensive 8-wicket victory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading a youthful Indian squad in Zimbabwe

events.title: 3-0 Whitewash & Selfless Trophy Handover in Harare
events.description: After completing a 3-0 clean sweep over Zimbabwe, Dhoni received the trophy and immediately handed it over to the youngest team members, standing quietly at the corner.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni smiling from the side as youngsters celebrate with the trophy

events.title: Champions Trophy 2013: Dominating Pakistan at Edgbaston
events.description: In a rain-interrupted marquee clash, Dhoni's bowlers bundled Pakistan out for 165 as India cruised to an 8-wicket DLS win, marching undefeated into the semifinals.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni walks off victorious at Edgbaston

events.title: World Cup 2019: 7-0 vs Pakistan at Old Trafford
events.description: In front of 26,000 electric fans in Manchester, Dhoni's India dismantled Pakistan by 89 runs (DLS), extending India's unblemished World Cup winning streak against Pakistan to 7-0.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni marshaling the fielding ring at Old Trafford

events.title: Pre-Series Net Sessions in Belfast
events.description: Dhoni adjusted to early summer swing in Belfast, Northern Ireland, preparing for India's ODIs against Ireland and South Africa.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in overcast conditions

events.title: Champions Trophy 2017: Final at The Oval
events.description: Dhoni kept wickets with concentration in the final of the ICC Champions Trophy at The Oval, providing steady counsel to captain Virat Kohli.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni behind the stumps at The Oval

events.title: Arrival in London for Landmark 5-Test Series
events.description: Dhoni arrived with his young Indian Test team in London, ready for a grueling 5-Test challenge across England's historic cricket grounds.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites arriving in England

events.title: Champions Trophy 2013: Routing Sri Lanka in Semifinal
events.description: Dhoni's pacers Ishant Sharma and Bhuvneshwar Kumar blew away Sri Lanka for 181 at Cardiff, as India stormed into the final with an 8-wicket stroll.
events.imageCaption: Team India advancing to the Champions Trophy Final

events.title: Refining Short-Format Tactics in London
events.description: Dhoni used the UK summer to study emerging trends in death bowling and boundary-riding positions that would soon transform modern T20 cricket.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni contemplating modern T20 strategy

events.title: World Cup 2019: The Southampton 11-Run Thriller
events.description: Dhoni scored 28 on a tricky pitch and advised Mohammed Shami in the final over, guiding him to a historic final-over World Cup hat-trick to defeat Afghanistan by 11 runs!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni setting the field for Shami's hat-trick

events.title: Champions Trophy 2013 Glory: Completing the ICC Treble!
events.description: India won the ICC Champions Trophy at Edgbaston in a rain-reduced 20-over thriller against England! Dhoni's inspired captaincy—giving Ishant the 18th over and Ashwin the 20th—won it by 5 runs. Dhoni became the ONLY captain in history to win all three ICC white-ball trophies: T20 World Cup, 50-over World Cup, and Champions Trophy!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni joyfully hops in celebration with the Champions Trophy

events.title: Belfast Chase vs Ireland
events.description: Dhoni helped guide India to a comfortable 9-wicket victory over Ireland in Belfast, braving freezing winds and damp pitches.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni walking off after victory in Ireland

events.title: Karachi 109* in 256-Run Asia Cup Rout
events.description: Dhoni blasted an unbeaten 109* off 96 balls (6 fours, 6 sixes) alongside Suresh Raina (101) as India demolished Hong Kong by 256 runs in Karachi.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates his blistering hundred in Karachi

events.title: Chasing 300 Against Pakistan in Karachi
events.description: Dhoni scored 26* to cap a brilliant run chase of 300 against Pakistan in Karachi, anchored by Virender Sehwag's 119.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni acknowledging the Karachi crowd after win

events.title: World Cup 2019: 56* & 16 in the 50th Over vs West Indies
events.description: Dhoni anchored India's innings at Old Trafford with 56* off 61 balls, taking Oshane Thomas for 16 runs in the 50th over (two sixes and a four) as India won by 125 runs.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat after finishing the innings in Manchester

events.title: Fighting 67 Against Sri Lanka in Asia Cup
events.description: Dhoni waged a lone battle with 67 off 85 balls against Muttiah Muralitharan and Ajantha Mendis in the Asia Cup Super Four match in Karachi.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting through the middle overs in Karachi

events.title: Belfast Battle vs South Africa
events.description: Dhoni struck 14* in a tight low-scoring contest in Belfast, setting up an intriguing decider against Graeme Smith's South Africa.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni running hard between the wickets

events.title: Mastering the Slow Pitch: 78* in Antigua
events.description: On a sluggish, sticky pitch at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium in Antigua, Dhoni played a vintage anchor knock of 78* off 79 balls to carry India to a match-winning 251/4.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates his fighting 78* in Antigua

events.title: Belfast Series Win over South Africa
events.description: Dhoni guided India to a 6-wicket win against South Africa in Belfast, ensuring an inspiring start to India's European summer tour.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading Team India in Ireland

events.title: Tactical Leadership from the Dugout in Kingston
events.description: After suffering a hamstring strain, Dhoni sat in the dugout in Jamaica, actively advising stand-in captain Virat Kohli and plotting bowling changes.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni providing tactical direction from the dugout

events.title: Old Trafford T20I: KL Rahul 101* & Keeping Perfection
events.description: Dhoni orchestrated a dominant 8-wicket win over England at Old Trafford, supporting KL Rahul's century and displaying flawless glovework.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni keeping at Old Trafford

events.title: Personal Milestone: Wedding with Sakshi Rawat
events.description: In a private, elegant ceremony at a resort near Dehradun, MS Dhoni married his childhood friend Sakshi Rawat, surrounded by close family and teammates.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni celebrating a major personal milestone

events.title: Unbeaten Century for India A vs Zimbabwe Select
events.description: During the landmark India A tour of Zimbabwe, Dhoni blasted an unbeaten century in Harare, sending warning signals to international bowling attacks.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni hitting big in Africa

events.title: 500th International Match: 32* in Cardiff
events.description: Playing his monumental 500th international match for India, Dhoni struck an unbeaten 32* off 24 balls against England at Sophia Gardens in Cardiff.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat in his 500th international match

events.title: The Legend is Born: Happy Birthday Thala MS Dhoni!
events.description: Mahendra Singh Dhoni was born in Ranchi, Bihar (now Jharkhand) to Pan Singh and Devaki Devi. Celebrated every year across the globe by millions of fans as World Dhoni Day and Thala's Birthday!
events.imageCaption: Celebrating the birth of a legend: Jersey No. 7

events.title: World Record: 5 Dismissals in a T20I at Bristol
events.description: Dhoni became the first wicketkeeper in T20I history to effect 5 dismissals in a single match (5 catches and a stumping) as India clinched the T20I series 2-1 in Bristol.
events.imageCaption: World record glovework: 5 dismissals in a T20I

events.title: World Cup 2019 Semifinal: Day 1 Rain Halt in Manchester
events.description: In the World Cup semifinal against New Zealand at Old Trafford, heavy Manchester rain halted play with NZ at 211/5, pushing the match into a dramatic reserve day.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni under gloomy Manchester skies

events.title: The Final International Innings: 50 in World Cup Semifinal
events.description: In his final international match for India, Dhoni walked in with India reeling at 92/6. He fought heroically, scoring 50 off 72 balls in a 116-run stand with Ravindra Jadeja (77). Martin Guptill's direct hit ended the chase by inches, closing the international curtain on a legendary career.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni battles till the very end in his final international match

events.title: Tri-Series Final: 15 off the Final Over in Trinidad!
events.description: India needed 15 in the final over with only 1 wicket in hand against Sri Lanka in Port of Spain. Dhoni, playing with an injured hamstring, faced Shaminda Eranga: Dot, Monster Six, Boundary, Monster Six! India lifted the Tri-Nation Trophy in unbelievable Dhoni style!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni holds the high follow-through after smashing the winning six in Trinidad

events.title: Trent Bridge Masterclass: Kuldeep 6/25 Guided by Dhoni
events.description: Dhoni expertly guided wrist-spinner Kuldeep Yadav to career-best figures of 6/25 as India crushed England by 8 wickets at Trent Bridge.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni plotting dismissals with Kuldeep Yadav

events.title: NatWest Final Inspiration in Kharagpur Quarters
events.description: Watching Sourav Ganguly wave his jersey at Lord's from his modest railway quarters in Kharagpur, young ticket collector Dhoni was filled with the unshakable belief that he too belonged on cricket's biggest stage.
events.imageCaption: The fire ignited in young Dhoni during his Kharagpur days

events.title: Monumental 10,000 ODI Runs Milestone at Lord's
events.description: At the Home of Cricket, Lord's, MS Dhoni crossed 10,000 ODI runs, becoming only the second wicketkeeper-batsman in cricket history after Kumar Sangakkara to achieve this immortal landmark.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat for 10,000 ODI runs at Lord's

events.title: Explosive 70 Against Zimbabwe A
events.description: Dhoni smashed 70 off 48 balls in Harare for India A, leaving African coaches and visiting journalists amazed by his bottom-hand hitting power.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni powers boundaries in Harare

events.title: Shattering Beep-Test Fitness Benchmarks
events.description: At the National Cricket Academy in Bengaluru, Dhoni clocked the squad's fastest sprint and highest beep-test endurance scores, setting new standards for Indian wicketkeepers.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni pushing fitness limits at the NCA

events.title: Headingley Fight: 42 Under Cloud Cover
events.description: Dhoni fought patiently with 42 off 66 balls amidst swinging English conditions at Headingley, Leeds, absorbing pressure against Adil Rashid and David Willey.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni battling the swinging ball in Leeds

events.title: Mentoring Grassroots Talents at JSCA Stadium
events.description: During a home break, Dhoni spent hours at the JSCA International Stadium in Ranchi, mentoring young state-level cricketers and personally wicketkeeping in net sessions.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni at the JSCA nets in Ranchi

events.title: Lord's Test Saved: Heroic 76* in the Rain
events.description: With India on the brink of defeat chasing 380 at Lord's, Dhoni stood resolute for 159 balls, scoring an unbeaten 76* alongside the tail to save the Test match as rain fell!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites saves the Lord's Test

events.title: Historic Lord's Test Victory After 28 Years
events.description: Dhoni devised the brilliant short-ball bouncer strategy for Ishant Sharma (7/74), engineering India's first Test victory at Lord's in 28 years on a historic summer afternoon!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates a historic Test win at Lord's

events.title: Lord's 2000th Test in Cricket History
events.description: Dhoni led India in the historic 2000th Test match in cricket history and the 100th Test between India and England at Lord's, London.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni behind the stumps at Lord's in the 2000th Test

events.title: Devastating Ball-Striking in Nairobi Nets
events.description: In the high altitude of Nairobi, Dhoni's shots repeatedly cleared the Gymkhana ground perimeter, leaving India A coach Sandeep Patil speechless.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni practicing big hits in Nairobi

events.title: The Lord's Blockathon Masterclass
events.description: Dhoni's gritty blockathon at Lord's demonstrated his immense technical versatility, proving he could defend doggedly when the team's survival demanded it.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni's resolute defensive technique

events.title: Preparation for Southampton Test
events.description: Following the Lord's victory, Dhoni worked with Indian pacers in Southampton on reverse swing and disciplined line and length.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni drilling bowling plans in Southampton

events.title: Dhoni Bowls at Lord's & Nearly Dismisses Pietersen
events.description: Handing his wicketkeeping pads to Rahul Dravid, Dhoni bowled medium pace at Lord's and trapped Kevin Pietersen plumb LBW, only for DRS to narrowly overturn it on height!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni bowling medium pace in Test cricket at Lord's

events.title: Arrival at Trent Bridge for Pivotal 2nd Test
events.description: Dhoni arrived in Nottingham with the Indian squad, energized by the resolute Lord's draw and ready to push for a series victory.
events.imageCaption: Team India arriving at Trent Bridge

events.title: Fighting 50 in Southampton Test
events.description: Dhoni played a defiant knock of 50 in the 1st innings at the Ageas Bowl in Southampton, counter-attacking against James Anderson and Stuart Broad.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in action at Southampton

events.title: The Trent Bridge Jelly Bean Test Begins
events.description: Dhoni supported Zaheer Khan during the famous 'jelly bean' incident at Trent Bridge, helping channel the fast bowler's fury into a devastating match-winning spell.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni strategizing with Zaheer Khan

events.title: Spirit of Cricket: Recalling Ian Bell at Trent Bridge
events.description: After Ian Bell was controversially run out on the stroke of tea, Dhoni held a team meeting and decided to withdraw the appeal, recalling Bell to bat. The gesture earned him the ICC Spirit of Cricket Award!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni honoured with ICC Spirit of Cricket Award

events.title: Gymkhana Blast: Dismantling Zimbabwe A
events.description: Playing for India A in Nairobi, Dhoni struck clean boundaries to all corners of the ground, confirming his readiness for international cricket.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni blasting sixes in Nairobi

events.title: Joining 106 Territorial Army Battalion in Kashmir
events.description: Dhoni officially began a two-month military deployment with the 106 Territorial Army Battalion (Para) in Jammu and Kashmir, taking on duties as an honorary Lieutenant Colonel.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni serving his nation in the armed forces

events.title: Patrolling and Guard Duties with Victor Force
events.description: Stationed in South Kashmir with the Victor Force, Lieutenant Colonel (Honorary) Dhoni carried out regular guard duties and static security patrols alongside soldiers.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni standing shoulder-to-shoulder with Indian soldiers

events.title: Galle Test: Sehwag's 201* & Dhoni's 33
events.description: Dhoni supported Virender Sehwag's legendary 201* carrying his bat in Galle, contributing 33 in tough spinning conditions against Muralitharan.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Galle Test whites

events.title: Towering Sixes in Nairobi Gymkhana
events.description: Dhoni launched two colossal sixes over the grandstand in Nairobi, as local crowds gathered specifically to watch the fearless long-haired Indian keeper bat.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni's high follow-through in Nairobi

events.title: Historic 7-Wicket Win at Trent Bridge
events.description: Dhoni's India sealed a 7-wicket victory over England at Trent Bridge, taking a 1-0 series lead on their march to winning the Test series on English soil.
events.imageCaption: Team India walks proud after winning at Trent Bridge

events.title: Playing Cricket with Soldiers in Awantipora
events.description: During downtime in Awantipora, Kashmir, Dhoni played volleyball and cricket with troops and local youths, inspiring everyone with his down-to-earth humility.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni enjoying cricket with troops in Kashmir

events.title: Lightning Stumpings at Nairobi
events.description: Dhoni demonstrated superhuman reflexes behind the stumps in Nairobi, catching the eye of national selectors watching tournament match footage.
events.imageCaption: Lightning gloves in Nairobi

events.title: Grit in the Manchester Swing: 71 off 133 Balls
events.description: With India collapsing to 8/4 in treacherous swinging conditions at Old Trafford, Dhoni fought like a warrior, scoring 71 off 133 balls (almost half the team's total of 152).
events.imageCaption: Dhoni battling swinging conditions at Old Trafford

events.title: Toughing it Out at Colombo PSS
events.description: Dhoni scored a determined 25 in Colombo against Mendis and Muralitharan, refining his bat-pad positioning against mystery spin.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni negotiating spin in Colombo

events.title: Devastating 92 off 81 Balls at The Oval
events.description: Dhoni tore England apart at The Oval, smashing 92 off just 81 balls with 9 fours and 4 sixes in an electric partnership with Anil Kumble (110*).
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launches into England at The Oval

events.title: Inspiring Army School Students in Srinagar
events.description: Dhoni visited the Army Public School in Srinagar, spending hours answering students' questions about mental toughness, fitness, and love for the country.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni interacting with young students in Srinagar

events.title: Historic Test Series Victory in England (1-0)
events.description: India drew the 3rd Test at The Oval to win the Test Series in England 1-0! It was India's first Test series triumph in England since 1986, with Dhoni a bedrock throughout.
events.imageCaption: Team India celebrates Test series win in England

events.title: Blazing 70 vs Pakistan A in Nairobi
events.description: Dhoni blasted 70 runs against Pakistan A in Nairobi, attacking future international stars with utter contempt.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni dominates Pakistan A in Kenya

events.title: Appointed Captain for Inaugural ICC World Twenty20
events.description: In a historic decision, the BCCI selection committee appointed 26-year-old MS Dhoni as captain of the Indian cricket team for the first-ever ICC World Twenty20 in South Africa!
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni appointed Captain of India for World Twenty20

events.title: Whirlwind 40* in Kenya Tri-Series
events.description: Dhoni smashed an unbeaten 40* in just 22 balls, concluding another dominant win for India A in Nairobi.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni hitting boundaries in Kenya

events.title: 'Consider Me As Retired From 1929 Hrs'
events.description: On India's 74th Independence Day at 19:29 hrs, MS Dhoni announced his retirement from international cricket with a poignant 4-minute video set to 'Main Pal Do Pal Ka Shayar Hoon'. It marked the end of an immortal 16-year international journey of 538 matches, 17,266 runs, 829 dismissals, and all 3 ICC white-ball trophies.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni looks toward the sky: Main Pal Do Pal Ka Shayar Hoon

events.title: Sensational 120 off 122 Balls vs Pakistan A
events.description: Dhoni announced himself as an unstoppable force, smashing 120 off 122 balls with 10 fours and 2 sixes against Pakistan A at Nairobi Gymkhana to win by 8 wickets!
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni celebrates a blistering century against Pakistan A

events.title: Colombo Warm-Ups Before Maiden Full Tour
events.description: Dhoni led fielding drills in Colombo ahead of his first overseas tour as full-time ODI captain, emphasizing athleticism in the ring.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni enjoying team training in Colombo

events.title: Back-to-Back Century: Unbeaten 119* vs Pakistan A
events.description: Just two days after his 120, Dhoni bludgeoned an unbeaten 119* off 124 balls against Pakistan A, finishing the tour with 362 runs at an average of 72.40 and sealing his spot in the senior Indian team!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni powers to back-to-back hundreds in Nairobi

events.title: Dambulla: Full Captaincy Debut & Virat Kohli's Debut
events.description: Dhoni took charge for his first overseas series as full-time ODI captain at Dambulla, handing a 19-year-old Virat Kohli his international debut for India.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni with debutant Virat Kohli in Dambulla

events.title: Fighting 62 at The Oval in Test Whites
events.description: Dhoni counter-attacked with 62 off 106 balls against Graeme Swann and Tim Bresnan at The Oval, showing resolve in tough overseas circumstances.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites at The Oval

events.title: Kenya Tri-Series Champions & Player of Tournament
events.description: India A defeated Pakistan A to win the Tri-Series in Nairobi. Dhoni was named Player of the Tournament, returning home as the hottest batting prospect in Indian cricket.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni holding the trophy in Nairobi

events.title: Pallekele Net Drills with Spinners
events.description: Dhoni spent hours working with Axar Patel and Yuzvendra Chahal in Pallekele, guiding them on bowling trajectory and deception.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni instructing young spinners in nets

events.title: Guiding 3-Wicket Win at Dambulla
events.description: Dhoni scored 39 and added an unbroken partnership to steer India home by 3 wickets in a low-scoring thriller at Dambulla.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in chase mode at Dambulla

events.title: Pallekele Miracle: 100-Run Unbroken Stand with Bhuvi
events.description: Chasing 231, Akila Dananjaya took 6 wickets as India crashed to 131/7. Dhoni remained unshakable, scoring 45* in an extraordinary 100-run stand with Bhuvneshwar Kumar (53*) to pull off an impossible victory!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and Bhuvneshwar Kumar celebrate miraculous win in Pallekele

events.title: Hero's Welcome in Ranchi After Kenya Tour
events.description: Dhoni arrived back in Ranchi to roaring crowds and flower garlands, recognized across Bihar and Jharkhand as the next big star of Indian cricket.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni smiling in Ranchi

events.title: Blistering 76 off 80 Balls in Colombo
events.description: Dhoni struck 76 off 80 balls with 8 boundaries at R. Premadasa Stadium in Colombo, anchoring India to a 33-run win over Sri Lanka.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat after seventy in Colombo

events.title: Unbeaten 67* with Rohit Sharma's Century
events.description: Dhoni scored 67* off 86 balls, partnering Rohit Sharma (124*) in an unbeaten 157-run stand to secure a 6-wicket win in Pallekele.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni anchoring another chase in Sri Lanka

events.title: Historic USA Debut: Leading India in Florida
events.description: Dhoni captained India in the first official bilateral international matches on American soil at Central Broward Regional Park in Lauderhill, Florida.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Lauderhill, Florida

events.title: Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna: India's Highest Sporting Honour
events.description: On National Sports Day, President Pratibha Patil conferred the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna upon MS Dhoni at Rashtrapati Bhavan, recognising his immortal T20 World Cup triumph and leadership.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni conferred the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna

events.title: First-Ever Bilateral ODI Series Win in Sri Lanka
events.description: Dhoni scored 71 off 80 balls in Colombo as India clinched the 5-match ODI series 3-1—India's first-ever bilateral ODI series triumph on Sri Lankan soil!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates historic series win in Sri Lanka

events.title: 300th ODI Match & Platinum Bat Honour
events.description: In his 300th ODI match at Colombo, Dhoni scored an unbeaten 49* off 42 balls and recorded his 99th ODI stumping. Captain Virat Kohli presented him with a commemorative platinum bat on behalf of Team India.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni honoured on his 300th ODI appearance

events.title: Departure for Inaugural World Twenty20 in South Africa
events.description: Captain MS Dhoni led a youthful, fearless Indian squad aboard the flight to South Africa, embarking on the tournament that would change cricket history.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and young India embarking on history

events.title: Fighting 67 with Kaif in Harare Tri-Series
events.description: Dhoni scored 67 off 81 balls in a 102-run partnership with Mohammad Kaif against New Zealand at Harare Sports Club.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in his early international colours in Harare

events.title: World Record: First Wicketkeeper to 100 ODI Stumpings!
events.description: In Colombo, Dhoni whipped off the bails to stump Akila Dananjaya off Yuzvendra Chahal, becoming the FIRST wicketkeeper in cricket history to reach 100 ODI stumpings!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni's legendary hands complete 100th ODI stumping

events.title: Unbeaten 56* in Harare Run Chase
events.description: Dhoni struck 56* off just 45 balls with 5 boundaries against Zimbabwe, showcasing ruthless efficiency in closing out run chases.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni finishing the match in Harare

events.title: Rain-Interrupted Battle at Chester-le-Street
events.description: Dhoni scored a patient 33 in cold, drizzly English conditions, stabilizing India against James Anderson and Graeme Swann.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in overcast English weather

events.title: Historic 9-0 All-Format Clean Sweep in Sri Lanka
events.description: Dhoni finished the chase in the one-off T20I in Colombo, as India completed an unprecedented 9-0 clean sweep across all formats (3 Tests, 5 ODIs, 1 T20I) in Sri Lanka!
events.imageCaption: Team India celebrates the historic 9-0 tour sweep

events.title: High-Intensity Fitness Drills in Ranchi
events.description: Dhoni trained in Ranchi, incorporating football and sprinting into his routine ahead of the blockbuster home Test series against Ricky Ponting's Australia.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni enjoying high-intensity fitness drills

events.title: Tactical Field Management in Southampton Rain
events.description: Dhoni rotated bowlers constantly during rain interruptions in Southampton, adapting to wet ball conditions with trademark tactical composure.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni directing his field in wet conditions

events.title: The Fearless Team Talk in Johannesburg
events.description: Ahead of India's World T20 opener, Dhoni urged his team to play without fear or baggage: 'If we enjoy the game, the results will take care of themselves.'
events.imageCaption: Dhoni instilling fearlessness into his young side

events.title: ICC ODI Player of the Year Award in Dubai
events.description: At the ICC Awards ceremony in Dubai, MS Dhoni was crowned the ICC ODI Player of the Year, becoming the first Indian cricketer in history to receive the honour.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni honoured with ICC ODI Player of the Year

events.title: Resolute 69 off 103 Balls at The Oval
events.description: Dhoni stood firm against an inspired English pace attack, scoring 69 off 103 balls to drag India to a respectable total at The Oval.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting with grit at The Oval

events.title: World Twenty20: Durban Washout vs Scotland
events.description: India's World T20 campaign started with a rain abandonment against Scotland in Durban, heightening the stakes for the upcoming clash with Pakistan.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni waits out the rain in Durban

events.title: The Secret Bowl-Out Practice in Durban
events.description: Anticipating tight finishes, Dhoni held a dedicated bowl-out session in Durban, testing batsmen Virender Sehwag and Robin Uthappa for their stump-hitting accuracy.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni designing the secret bowl-out strategy

events.title: The Legendary Bowl-Out vs Pakistan in Durban!
events.description: Match tied at 141! In cricket's most famous bowl-out, Dhoni chose Sehwag, Uthappa, and Harbhajan, kneeling directly behind the middle stump as a laser target. India hit 3 out of 3; Pakistan hit 0. India won 3-0 in immortal drama!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni kneels directly behind the middle stump as the target in the bowl-out

events.title: Cheering Virat Kohli's 72* in Mohali
events.description: Following his international sabbatical, Dhoni watched from Ranchi as Virat Kohli guided India past South Africa at Mohali, with Kohli dedicating the win to Dhoni's influence.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and Kohli's unbreakable brotherhood

events.title: Lord's Thriller: 78* off 71 Balls in DLS Tie
events.description: Dhoni played a sensational counter-attacking innings of 78* off 71 balls with 6 fours and 3 sixes at Lord's, in a breathless rain-affected match that ended in a dramatic tie.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat to a packed Lord's pavilion

events.title: Chepauk Rescue: 79 off 88 Balls with Pandya
events.description: India collapsed to 87/5 against Australia at Chepauk. Dhoni received a thunderous ovation, scoring 79 off 88 balls in a 118-run partnership with Hardik Pandya (83) to propel India to an improbable 26-run win!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat to an electric Chepauk crowd

events.title: World Twenty20: Super Eights vs New Zealand
events.description: Dhoni scored 24 at Wanderers, Johannesburg, keeping the squad focused on net run-rate calculations in a high-intensity Super Eights battle.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni pushing for runs at Wanderers

events.title: Watching Yuvraj's 6 Sixes from Non-Striker's End
events.description: In Durban against England, Dhoni watched from 22 yards away as Yuvraj Singh famously smashed 6 sixes in an over off Stuart Broad, celebrating each blow with sheer delight.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates with Yuvraj Singh in Durban

events.title: Knocking Out Hosts South Africa in Durban
events.description: Rohit Sharma scored 50* while Dhoni contributed 45 off 33 balls before RP Singh took 4 wickets, as India knocked hosts South Africa out of the World T20 to storm into the semifinals!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leads India into the World Twenty20 Semifinals

events.title: Kuldeep's Eden Gardens Hat-Trick Directed by Dhoni
