events.description: Behind the stumps in Kolkata, Dhoni guided young spinner Kuldeep Yadav ball-by-ball, helping him take a historic ODI hat-trick against Australia at Eden Gardens.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni guiding Kuldeep Yadav's hat-trick at Eden Gardens

events.title: World Twenty20 Semifinal: Dethroning Australia in Durban
events.description: Dhoni smashed 36 off 18 balls following Yuvraj's 70 off 30, as India scored 188/5 and defeated the mighty Australian world champions by 15 runs to enter the World T20 Final!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni smashes boundaries against Australia in the 2007 Semifinal

events.title: The 'Dhoni Review System' Perfect DRS Against Pakistan
events.description: In Dubai, Dhoni signaled DRS within 2 seconds of an appeal against Babar Azam, overturning the umpire's decision and cementing the popular title 'Dhoni Review System'.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni with the DRS T-sign

events.title: World T20 Champions 2007: Joginder's Over & The Miracle
events.description: India became the inaugural ICC World Twenty20 Champions at Wanderers, Johannesburg! Dhoni entrusted the final over to Joginder Sharma with 13 needed. Misbah scooped to Sreesanth at short fine-leg. India won by 5 runs! Dhoni handed his match jersey to a young fan in immortal celebration.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni joyfully lifts the 2007 ICC World Twenty20 Trophy in Johannesburg

events.title: 200th ODI as Captain: Leading India One Last Time
events.description: 692 days after stepping down, Dhoni walked out for the toss against Afghanistan in Dubai as stand-in captain, captaining India for the 200th and final time in ODIs in a thrilling tie.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni captains India for the 200th time in ODIs

events.title: Champions League T20 Champions: CSK Lifts Maiden CLT20
events.description: At the Wanderers in Johannesburg, Dhoni led Chennai Super Kings to an 8-wicket rout of Warriors to lift their maiden Champions League T20 trophy, completing the IPL-CLT20 double!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and CSK celebrate winning the 2010 Champions League T20

events.title: CLT20: Dominating Perth Scorchers in Bengaluru
events.description: Dhoni orchestrated a comprehensive win over Australia's Big Bash champions Perth Scorchers at Chinnaswamy Stadium, with Ravindra Jadeja starring.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni behind the stumps in CLT20

events.title: Asia Cup 2018 Champions: Final-Ball Thriller in Dubai
events.description: Dhoni scored 36 and marshaled the lower order in Dubai as India chased down Bangladesh off the very last ball of the tournament to lift their 7th Asia Cup title.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrating with the Asia Cup trophy in Dubai

events.title: Debut as Full-Time ODI Captain vs Australia
events.description: At M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, MS Dhoni took the field for his official debut as India's full-time ODI captain, beginning an era that would redefine Indian cricket.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leads Team India out for his first match as full-time ODI captain

events.title: The Biopic: 'M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story' Releases Worldwide
events.description: The biographical feature film 'M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story', starring Sushant Singh Rajput and directed by Neeraj Pandey, released worldwide to record-breaking box office success and overwhelming critical praise, touching hearts across the globe.
events.imageCaption: The Untold Story of MS Dhoni inspires millions across the globe

events.title: Historic Back-to-Back ICC ODI Player of the Year
events.description: MS Dhoni was crowned ICC ODI Player of the Year for the second consecutive year (2008 & 2009), becoming the first cricketer in history to achieve back-to-back honours in this prestigious category.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni honoured with back-to-back ICC ODI Player of the Year awards

events.title: Unbeaten 31* in Kochi Heat vs Australia
events.description: Dhoni fought through humid conditions at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Kochi, scoring an unbeaten 31* to anchor India's middle order.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni taking drinks in humid Kochi conditions

events.title: Chepauk Drills for Champions League T20
events.description: Dhoni conducted intensive night-training sessions under the Chepauk lights, fine-tuning death overs bowling and fielding angles for CSK.
events.imageCaption: Chepauk glows under the floodlights

events.title: Champions League T20 Champions: CSK Lifts 2nd CLT20
events.description: At M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bangalore, Suresh Raina smashed 109* while Dhoni finished the match with a boundary, as CSK defeated KKR by 8 wickets to lift their second Champions League T20 title!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni lifts the 2014 Champions League T20 trophy in Bengaluru

events.title: Composed 33 in Hyderabad vs Australia
events.description: Dhoni provided middle-order resistance with 33 against a menacing Australian bowling attack featuring Brett Lee and Mitchell Johnson.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Hyderabad against Australia

events.title: World T20 Strategic Review in Colombo
events.description: Following the 2012 World T20 in Sri Lanka, Dhoni laid down clear tactical blueprints emphasizing multi-skilled all-rounders in short-format cricket.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in tactical discussions in Colombo

events.title: Ranchi Homecoming: Leading India at JSCA Stadium
events.description: In front of 39,000 adoring home fans in Ranchi, Dhoni took the field at the stadium with a pavilion named after him, as India defeated Australia in a rain-affected T20I.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni salutes his home fans in Ranchi

events.title: Fighting 50 off 61 Balls in Chandigarh
events.description: Dhoni struck a counter-attacking 50 off 61 balls against Australia in Chandigarh, maintaining his reputation as India's premier crisis manager.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni salutes after reaching fifty in Chandigarh

events.title: Champions Trophy Net Preparation in Jaipur
events.description: At the Sawai Mansingh Stadium in Jaipur—the ground where he scored his immortal 183*—Dhoni spent hours striking balls onto the pavilion roof in practice.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in practice at Sawai Mansingh Stadium

events.title: Explosive 51* off 40 Balls vs West Indies at Kotla
events.description: Dhoni blasted an unbeaten 51* off 40 balls with 5 boundaries and a six, powering India to 263 and securing a 48-run victory over the West Indies in Delhi.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni acknowledges applause after rapid fifty in Delhi

events.title: Resolute 26 at Reliance Stadium, Vadodara
events.description: Dhoni contributed 26 crucial runs in a low-scoring, seaming encounter against Australia at Vadodara.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni running hard between wickets in Vadodara

events.title: Visiting Teammates in Hyderabad Dressing Room
events.description: Dhoni visited the Indian dressing room during the 2nd Test against West Indies in Hyderabad, sharing laughs and advising young wicketkeeper Rishabh Pant.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni smiling with Indian teammates in Hyderabad

events.title: Chasing Heavy Runs vs Australia in Pune
events.description: Dhoni battled in the middle order against Australia at MCA Stadium in Pune, initiating a high-scoring bilateral series filled with historic run-chases.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Pune against Australia

events.title: Nagpur Blitz: 50* off 35 Balls vs Australia
events.description: Dhoni unleashed a whirlwind 50* off just 35 deliveries with 5 fours and a six against Australia at Vidarbha Cricket Association Ground in Nagpur.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni powers to fifty in Nagpur

events.title: 4th IPL Title: CSK Wins IPL 2021 in Dubai
events.description: Chennai Super Kings won their 4th IPL championship! Faf du Plessis struck 86 as CSK posted 192/3, defeating Kolkata Knight Riders by 27 runs in the final at Dubai International Stadium. Dhoni lifted the trophy with trademark calmness.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and CSK lift the IPL 2021 trophy in Dubai

events.title: The 360 Chase at Jaipur: Dhoni Cheers From Dugout
events.description: At Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Rohit Sharma (141*) and Virat Kohli (100* off 52) chased down 360 in just 43.3 overs, with Dhoni smiling proudly from the dugout.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni with Kohli after historic Jaipur chase

events.title: Murali Kartik 6/27 & 2-Wicket Win at Wankhede
events.description: Dhoni deployed Murali Kartik (6/27) to bundle Australia out for 193, then guided India's tail over the line in a tense 2-wicket win at Wankhede.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni orchestrating the field at Wankhede

events.title: Champions Trophy Battle in Ahmedabad
events.description: Dhoni scored 18 in a tense, low-scoring group match against Brian Lara's West Indies at Motera Stadium in Ahmedabad.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Ahmedabad

events.title: Masterclass 139* off 121 Balls vs Australia in Mohali
events.description: With India reduced to 76/4 against Australia in Mohali, Dhoni played one of his greatest ODI centuries: an unbeaten 139* off 121 balls with 12 fours and 5 sixes to lift India to 303!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates his majestic 139* in Mohali

events.title: Brabourne T20 Triumph over World Champions Australia
events.description: Dhoni captained India to an emphatic 7-wicket win over Ricky Ponting's Australia at Brabourne Stadium, Mumbai, proving their World T20 victory was no fluke.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates victory over Australia at Brabourne

events.title: Guwahati Run Fest: Keeping Wickets in 323 Chase
events.description: Dhoni kept wickets impeccably as Rohit Sharma (152*) and Virat Kohli (140) demolished West Indies by 8 wickets in Guwahati.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni keeping in Guwahati

events.title: Chepauk Spin Squeeze: 35-Run Win vs South Africa
events.description: Following Virat Kohli's 138, Dhoni spun a web around AB de Villiers and South Africa with Harbhajan and Axar to win by 35 runs at Chepauk.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni placing fielders at Chepauk

events.title: Motorcycle Passion & Ranchi Garage Ride
events.description: During a brief break, Dhoni spent time in Ranchi tuning his prized vintage motorcycles, famously riding his Yamaha RD350 through the streets of Ranchi.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni on a motorcycle lap around the stadium

events.title: Thrilling Vizag Tie vs West Indies
events.description: Dhoni contributed 20 runs in the middle order as India and West Indies played out a heart-stopping 321-run tie at ACA-VDCA Stadium in Visakhapatnam.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Vizag

events.title: Nagpur 350 Total: 38 off 28 vs Sri Lanka
events.description: Dhoni blasted 38 off just 28 balls in the 1st ODI against Sri Lanka in Nagpur as India piled on a massive 350/6 to win by 152 runs.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni striking big in Nagpur

events.title: Champions Trophy Battle vs Australia in Mohali
events.description: Dhoni struck 28 against Glenn McGrath and Brett Lee in the Champions Trophy knockout group clash at Mohali.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni pulls against Australian pace in Mohali

events.title: Superhuman Running Catch in Pune at Age 37
events.description: At age 37, Dhoni sprinted 30 yards backward towards fine leg, keeping his eyes on a swirling top edge to take a miraculous diving catch to dismiss Chandrapaul Hemraj in Pune!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni takes a miraculous running catch in Pune

events.title: Lightning Stumping of Upul Tharanga in Mohali
events.description: Dhoni announced his revolutionary wicketkeeping technique, removing the bails in a fraction of a second to dismiss Upul Tharanga off Harbhajan Singh.
events.imageCaption: Lightning stumping technique behind the stumps

events.title: Mishra 5/18: Spinning Out New Zealand for 79 in Vizag
events.description: Dhoni's tactical bowling changes unlocked Amit Mishra (5/18) as India skittled New Zealand for 79 in Visakhapatnam, winning the 5-match ODI series 3-2.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni setting field for Amit Mishra in Vizag

events.title: Finishing the Nagpur Chase vs Australia
events.description: Dhoni hit the winning runs as India chased down Australia's 350 at VCA Stadium in Nagpur, powered by centuries from Shikhar Dhawan and Virat Kohli.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni finishes the chase in Nagpur

events.title: The Immortal 183* vs Sri Lanka in Jaipur: World Record!
events.description: Sri Lanka set 299 in Jaipur. Promoted to No. 3, 24-year-old MS Dhoni played the defining innings of his life: an astonishing 183* off 145 balls with 15 fours and 10 colossal sixes! It remains the HIGHEST individual score by a wicketkeeper in ODI history!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni launches into his immortal 183* in Jaipur

events.title: Honorary Lieutenant Colonel Rank in Territorial Army
events.description: President Pratibha Patil formally conferred the honorary rank of Lieutenant Colonel in the Parachute Regiment (106 TA Battalion) of the Indian Territorial Army upon MS Dhoni at a special investiture ceremony.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni honoured with Lieutenant Colonel rank in the Territorial Army

events.title: Bengaluru Carnage: 62 off 38 Balls in Rohit's 209 Match
events.description: Dhoni bludgeoned 62 off just 38 balls with 7 fours and 2 sixes, sharing a 167-run partnership with double-centurion Rohit Sharma (209) as India posted 383/6 to defeat Australia in Bengaluru!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates during the Bengaluru carnage

events.title: Unbeaten 45* Chasing 262 in Pune
events.description: Fresh off his 183*, Dhoni guided India home with an unbeaten 45* off 43 balls against Sri Lanka in Pune, wrapping up a 4-wicket victory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in complete control of the Pune chase

events.title: Ahmedabad Test vs New Zealand
events.description: Dhoni managed his batting order as Virender Sehwag scored 173 at Motera in Ahmedabad, laying the groundwork for a drawn 1st Test.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites at Motera

events.title: Hyderabad Thriller: Sachin's 175 & 3-Run Cliffhanger
events.description: Dhoni captained India in one of the greatest ODIs ever played at Hyderabad, where Sachin Tendulkar's heroic 175 took India to the brink of chasing 350 against Australia.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni captaining India in high-pressure matches

events.title: Appointed Full-Time Test Captain of India at Nagpur
events.description: Following Anil Kumble's retirement, MS Dhoni was officially appointed full-time Test captain of India. In his first match at Nagpur, he scored a gritty 56 in the 1st innings against Australia.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni takes charge as full-time Test captain of India

events.title: Rajkot Blitz: 80 off 73 Balls vs Sri Lanka
events.description: Dhoni smashed 80 off 73 balls with 9 fours and 3 sixes against Sri Lanka at Madhavrao Scindia Cricket Ground in Rajkot, proving unstoppable in his first home season.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking boundaries in Rajkot

events.title: Guwahati Tactical Masterclass vs Australia
events.description: Dhoni read the seaming Guwahati surface perfectly, deploying Ravindra Jadeja to restrict Australia to 123 in a 6-wicket Indian victory.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni orchestrating the field in Guwahati

events.title: Departing for South Africa Fast Bowling Challenge
events.description: Dhoni prepared his batting stance for extra bounce ahead of India's departure for the 2006 tour of South Africa.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni working against high bounce in nets

events.title: Nagpur 172-Run Win: Border-Gavaskar Trophy Triumph!
events.description: India defeated Ricky Ponting's Australia by 172 runs at Nagpur! Dhoni celebrated his first series as full-time Test captain with a 2-0 Border-Gavaskar Trophy triumph, famously letting departing captain Kumble and Sourav Ganguly lead the lap of honour.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates winning the Border-Gavaskar Trophy in Nagpur

events.title: Kotla Test: 5-Wicket Win Over West Indies
events.description: Dhoni led India to a clinical 5-wicket victory at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi, with Ravichandran Ashwin making a sensational debut.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites in Delhi

events.title: Securing 5-1 Series Lead vs Sri Lanka
events.description: Having already dismantled Sri Lanka with 346 runs in the series, Dhoni took a well-earned rest day as India marched to a 6-1 series rout.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni sharing a light moment with teammates

events.title: Cheering Rohit's 264 World Record at Eden Gardens
events.description: Resting before the grueling Australia Test series, Dhoni watched from home as Rohit Sharma smashed the monumental 264 world record against Sri Lanka.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrating Rohit Sharma's historic milestones

events.title: Rajkot 387 Total: 29* off 16 Balls vs England
events.description: Dhoni smashed an unbeaten 29* off just 16 balls alongside Yuvraj Singh (138*) as India blasted 387/5 to crush England by 158 runs in Rajkot.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni striking at 180 strike rate in Rajkot

events.title: Player of the Series Honour vs Sri Lanka (346 Runs)
events.description: Dhoni was awarded Player of the Series after amassing 346 runs at an average of 115.33 in 7 matches, cementing his status as India's premier match-winner.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni named Player of the Series against Sri Lanka

events.title: Majestic 110 vs Sri Lanka at Motera, Ahmedabad
events.description: Dhoni scored a magnificent Test century: 110 off 159 balls with 10 fours and a six, sharing a 224-run stand with Rahul Dravid (177) at Sardar Patel Stadium in Ahmedabad.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat for a superb Test century in Ahmedabad

events.title: Indore 54-Run Win Over England
events.description: Dhoni scored 24 and managed his bowlers cleanly at Maharani Usharaje Trust Cricket Ground in Indore to take a 2-0 series lead against England.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni leading India in Indore

events.title: Bludgeoning 144 off 175 Balls at Eden Gardens
events.description: Dhoni played a scintillating Test innings at Eden Gardens, smashing 144 off 175 balls with 10 fours as India posted 631 and defeated West Indies by an innings and 15 runs!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates his 144 at Eden Gardens

events.title: Fearless Cooch Behar U-19 Knock for Bihar
events.description: A teenage MS Dhoni showcased his signature bottom-hand bat speed for Bihar Under-19 against Assam at Keenan Stadium, Jamshedpur, hitting bowlers out of the ground.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni in representative cricket

events.title: Green Park Kanpur: 16-Run DLS Win vs England
events.description: Dhoni struck 29 runs in bad light and cold winds in Kanpur as India edged England by 16 runs via Duckworth-Lewis to go 3-0 up in the series.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in cold Kanpur conditions

events.title: Adjusting to Durban Pace and Bounce
events.description: Dhoni underwent rigorous wicketkeeping sessions in Durban, refining his gloves position against steep bounce from tall South African pacers.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni crouched in anticipation in South Africa

events.title: Kanpur Test: Pushing for Innings Win vs Sri Lanka
events.description: At Green Park, Kanpur, Dhoni guided India to a massive 642 total (Gambhir 167, Sehwag 131), taking complete control of the match.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites in Kanpur

events.title: Defending 166 in Rain-Shortened Bengaluru Match
events.description: Dhoni's tactical bowling rotations defended a low target of 166 in 22 overs against Kevin Pietersen's England at Chinnaswamy Stadium.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni setting the inner ring in rain-shortened match

events.title: Innings & 144 Runs Rout of Sri Lanka at Kanpur
events.description: Dhoni's India defeated Sri Lanka by an innings and 144 runs in Kanpur, moving to the brink of capturing the ICC World No. 1 Test ranking!
events.imageCaption: Team India walks off victorious in Kanpur

events.title: Battling Shaun Pollock's Swing at Kingsmead
events.description: Dhoni fought against early seam movement from Shaun Pollock and Makhaya Ntini on a green pitch in Durban.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni battling through pace in Durban

events.title: Cuttack 35 & 26/11 Series Interruption
events.description: Dhoni scored 35 as India defeated England in Cuttack. Following the tragic 26/11 attacks in Mumbai, Dhoni held emotional discussions with England captain Kevin Pietersen.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in serious discussion during a grave moment

events.title: Newlands Test Prep in Cape Town
events.description: Dhoni trained in the shadows of Table Mountain at Newlands, adjusting to coastal wind and bounce ahead of India's Test series.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni training at Newlands, Cape Town

events.title: Defiant 98 off 156 Balls vs New Zealand in Nagpur
events.description: Dhoni struck a commanding 98 off 156 balls with 12 fours and a six, falling just two runs short of a century as India crushed New Zealand by an innings and 198 runs!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni acknowledges applause after 98 in Nagpur

events.title: Eden Gardens 50 off 73 Balls vs Pakistan
events.description: Dhoni played an aggressive counter-attacking knock of 50 off 73 balls with 7 boundaries against Pakistan in the 2nd Test at Eden Gardens, Kolkata.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni salutes the Eden Gardens crowd

events.title: Grit at St George's Park, Port Elizabeth
events.description: Dhoni showed character against South Africa's pace battery on a lively surface at St George's Park in Port Elizabeth.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni fighting through pace in Port Elizabeth

events.title: International T20I Debut vs South Africa at Wanderers
events.description: MS Dhoni made his T20 International debut for India against South Africa at the Wanderers in Johannesburg—India's first-ever T20I match in cricket history! India won by 6 wickets.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni walking out in India's first-ever T20I match

events.title: Test Match Debut for India vs Sri Lanka at Chepauk
events.description: MS Dhoni made his Test Debut for India against Sri Lanka at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai, donning India Test cap No. 251 in what would become his eternal home ground.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni makes his Test debut in Chennai

events.title: Unbeaten 100* off 154 Balls in 726/9 Brabourne Total
events.description: Following Virender Sehwag's 293, Dhoni bludgeoned an unbeaten 100* off 154 balls with 3 sixes, declaring at a staggering 726/9 against Sri Lanka at Brabourne Stadium, Mumbai!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates his 100* at Brabourne Stadium

events.title: First Test Innings: Gutsy 30 off 54 Balls at Chepauk
events.description: Batting for the first time in Test cricket, Dhoni counter-attacked with 30 off 54 balls against Chaminda Vaas and Muttiah Muralitharan in rain-shortened conditions in Chennai.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni batting in his debut Test match

events.title: Supporting Sourav Ganguly's 239 in Bengaluru Test
events.description: Dhoni scored 29 in a solid partnership with former captain Sourav Ganguly (239) against Pakistan at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting alongside Ganguly in Bengaluru

events.title: India Becomes World No. 1 in Tests: Dhoni Lifts the Mace!
events.description: Under MS Dhoni's visionary captaincy, India defeated Sri Lanka by an innings and 24 runs at Brabourne Stadium, Mumbai, ascending to the WORLD NO. 1 ranking in ICC Test Cricket for the first time in history! Dhoni proudly hoisted the ICC Test Championship Mace.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni proudly hoists the ICC Test Championship Mace as World No. 1

events.title: Potchefstroom Warm-Up Against Rest of South Africa
events.description: Dhoni scored 31 and kept wickets cleanly in the tour warm-up match at Sedgars Park in Potchefstroom.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni keeping in South Africa warm-up match

events.title: Test Series Victory Over Pakistan (1-0)
events.description: India drew the 3rd Test in Bengaluru to claim a 1-0 Test series victory over arch-rivals Pakistan, with Dhoni contributing both behind and in front of the stumps.
events.imageCaption: Team India celebrates Test series win over Pakistan

events.title: Nagpur T20I Against Sri Lanka
events.description: Dhoni led India in a high-intensity T20 clash against Kumar Sangakkara's Sri Lanka at the newly built Jamtha Stadium in Nagpur.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in action in Nagpur T20I

events.title: Maiden Test 50: Blistering 51* off 51 Balls at Kotla
events.description: On the historic day Sachin Tendulkar scored his 35th Test hundred to surpass Sunil Gavaskar's record, Dhoni announced his Test arrival with his maiden fifty: 51* off just 51 balls against Sri Lanka in Delhi!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat for his maiden Test fifty in Delhi

events.title: Historic 387 Chase in Chennai Post-26/11
events.description: In an emotionally charged Test after the Mumbai terror attacks, Dhoni's India pulled off one of the greatest 4th-innings run-chases in cricket history: chasing 387 with Sachin Tendulkar (103*) and Yuvraj Singh (85*) at Chepauk!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni and Team India celebrate the emotional Chennai Test victory

events.title: Blistering 46 off 28 Balls to Chase 207 in Mohali
events.description: Dhoni smashed 46 off just 28 balls alongside Yuvraj Singh (60*) as India chased down a massive target of 207 against Sri Lanka in Mohali to record India's highest successful T20I chase at the time!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni strikes massive sixes to chase 207 in Mohali

events.title: Strategy Meeting Before Historic Wanderers Test
events.description: Dhoni met with Rahul Dravid and Greg Chappell in Johannesburg, developing bowling plans around Sreesanth and Zaheer Khan that would rewrite Indian cricket history in South Africa.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in strategy huddle in Johannesburg

events.title: Emotional Post-Match Speech Dedicated to Mumbai
events.description: Dhoni delivered a deeply moving post-match speech at Chepauk, dedicating India's historic Test victory to the victims and heroes of the 26/11 Mumbai attacks.
events.imageCaption: Captain Cool speaks with poise and heart

events.title: Historic 1st Test Victory on South African Soil!
events.description: At the Wanderers in Johannesburg, India won their first-ever Test match on South African soil, routing the Proteas by 123 runs! Dhoni effected key dismissals behind the stumps to complete history.
events.imageCaption: Team India celebrates their first-ever Test win in South Africa

events.title: Fighting 49 in Ahmedabad Test Rout
events.description: Dhoni scored 49 in the second innings as India crushed Sri Lanka by 259 runs at Motera Stadium, with Harbhajan Singh taking 7 wickets.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting in Ahmedabad

events.title: First-Ever Appearance at the Melbourne Cricket Ground
events.description: Dhoni stepped onto the historic turf of the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) for the first time in a tour match against Victoria, awed by the colosseum-like amphitheatre.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni walks onto the MCG for the first time

events.title: Sealing Permanent Indian Wicketkeeper Spot
events.description: With 148 runs and 11 dismissals in the series, Dhoni established himself beyond any doubt as India's permanent wicketkeeper across all formats, ending years of revolving-door selections.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni cements his place in Team India

events.title: Dominant 144 off 237 Balls vs England in Mohali
events.description: Dhoni struck a commanding Test hundred: 144 off 237 balls with 18 fours, batting alongside Gautam Gambhir (179) as India posted 453 to win the Test series against England 1-0!
events.imageCaption: Dhoni raises his bat for a magnificent century in Mohali

events.title: Ranji Trophy Fight for Bihar at Eden Gardens
events.description: Before his international breakthrough, Dhoni scored a fighting 48 for Bihar against a star-studded Bengal bowling attack at Eden Gardens, earning the respect of national selectors.
events.imageCaption: Young Dhoni batting for Bihar at Eden Gardens

events.title: Turning Adversity into Resolve in Cuttack
events.description: After facing a 2-match ban for a marginal slow over-rate in Cuttack, Dhoni used the time to analyze player fatigue and devise bowling workload management plans.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in quiet contemplation

events.title: Receiving India Cap No. 157 from Sourav Ganguly
events.description: On the eve of the 1st ODI in Chittagong, Bangladesh, Indian captain Sourav Ganguly handed 23-year-old MS Dhoni his official Team India ODI cap (Cap No. 157), welcoming the boy from Ranchi into the national team.
events.imageCaption: Young MS Dhoni receives his India ODI Cap No. 157

events.title: The International Debut: MS Dhoni Plays for India!
events.description: MS Dhoni made his international debut for India in the 1st ODI against Bangladesh at MA Aziz Stadium, Chittagong. He was run out for a duck off his very first ball, but his lightning wicketkeeping and calm composure laid the foundation for one of the greatest careers in sports history!
events.imageCaption: Young MS Dhoni on the day of his international debut

events.title: Bangalore T20I Clash vs Pakistan
events.description: Dhoni fought with 33 in the middle order as India took on arch-rivals Pakistan in a high-voltage Christmas Eve T20I at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni batting against Pakistan in Bengaluru

events.title: Christmas Day Triumph: Historic 87-Run Win in Durban!
events.description: At Kingsmead in Durban, Dhoni's India scored a historic 87-run Test victory over South Africa on Boxing Day eve! VVS Laxman's 96 and Dhoni's calm 21 set up the landmark win.
events.imageCaption: Team India celebrates winning the Boxing Day Test in Durban

events.title: Boxing Day Test at the MCG: The Final Test Begins
events.description: Dhoni took the field at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in front of 70,000 fans for the Boxing Day Test against Australia—the 90th and final Test match of his illustrious career.
events.imageCaption: MS Dhoni walks out for the Boxing Day Test at the MCG

events.title: Ahmedabad 11-Run Victory Over Pakistan
events.description: Dhoni blasted 33 off 23 balls alongside Yuvraj Singh (72) as India posted 192/5 and defeated Pakistan by 11 runs at Sardar Patel Stadium in Ahmedabad.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni celebrates winning against Pakistan in Ahmedabad

events.title: Boxing Day Test Day 3: Guiding Kohli & Rahane at the MCG
events.description: From the MCG dressing room, Dhoni watched Virat Kohli (169) and Ajinkya Rahane (147) put on 262 against Australia, satisfied that the future of Indian Test batting was secure.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni watching play from the MCG pavilion

events.title: Praising the Fast Bowlers After Durban Victory
events.description: Dhoni held a post-match press conference in Durban, praising Zaheer Khan and Sreesanth for aggressive swing bowling in challenging overseas conditions.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni addressing the media in Durban

events.title: Walking Away with Dignity: Retirement from Test Cricket
events.description: After batting out a fighting 24* to draw the Boxing Day Test at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, MS Dhoni quietly announced his retirement from Test cricket, walking away with 90 Tests, 4,876 runs, 6 centuries, 294 dismissals, and having led India to World No. 1. No farewell tour, no fanfare—pure Dhoni dignity.
events.imageCaption: Dhoni in Test whites walks off the MCG for the final time

events.title: New Year's Eve: Global Tributes to a Test Legend
events.description: On New Year's Eve, the global cricketing fraternity—from Sachin Tendulkar to Ricky Ponting and Brian Lara—united in paying glowing emotional tributes to MS Dhoni's revolutionary impact on Test cricket.
events.imageCaption: A legendary career immortalized in the hall of frames
